An Open Letter to Hideki Naganuma on GamerGate.

English Transcript

Dear Mr. Naganuma, you recently asked what GamerGate is and as someone who has been involved with GamerGate for over a year, I'd like to help you answer that question. At it's core GamerGate is gaming community's pushback against corruption and censorship in the industry. We are tired of political extremists of any stripe trying to gatekeep what games should and shouldn't exist. We stand for the artistic freedom of all developers to make the games that they want to create without fear of undue outside pressure and harassment.

Many corrupt games journalists have demonized and slandered us, claiming we are terrorists and misogynists, but scientific studies have proven these allegations false. We are just ordinary gamers and developers like you who are passionate about gaming and want to improve this industry. If you want to know more about GamerGate, I highly recommend talking to Japanese speaking GamerGate supporters and educated neutrals like Mombot, VoQn, Roninworks, Taro Yamada and Georgina Young. You can also reach us at the main GamerGate community, KotakuInAction on Reddit. There are also a wealth of resources linked below in the video description.

In closing, we don't hate women, we don't hate men, we don't hate anyone, we hate corruption and censorship. Thank you for your time.
